blocks.text: Gauss's law se mukhtalif charge configurations (tarteeb) ki electric intensity nikali ja sakti hai. Har dafa ek imaginary (khayali) band surface lete hain jo us point se guzarti hai jahan field nikalni ho. Is surface ko Gaussian surface kehte hain. Ise aise chuna jata hai ke us se flux aasani se nikal sake.
Misal ke taur par, ab us sphere ke bahar kisi point par field nikalte hain jis par charge q rakha ho.
